RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 50

An all-male panel is not evidence of discrimination by itself — it proves nothing about intent, and skewed panels are common. Don't lead with it. Mention it once, as context, not as your argument.

Your real argument is the qualification comparison: a master's in educational leadership plus five years actually doing deputy-principal work against "courses" and classroom years with no leadership record. For a leadership post, that gap is hard to explain away. Under EEA/EU equal treatment rules, if you show you were at least as qualified, the employer must prove sex played no role.

The unanswered request matters too. Send a written follow-up citing your legal right to a reasoned decision, with a deadline. Their silence or reasoning will tell you far more than the panel's composition.
